description.value: Houston Motor Inn is a family-run motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Houston, BC, operating since 1993. The two-storey property offers basic rooms alongside an on-site restaurant, making it a practical overnight stop on one of northern BC's main touring corridors. Pet-friendly policies and an RV area reflect its orientation toward travellers passing through the region.

address.value: 2940 Yellowhead 16 W, Houston, British Columbia V0J 1Z1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. Public laundry and free Wi-Fi are explicitly listed in the motel's amenity list on the /services page. There is no mention anywhere on the site of bike storage, bike procedures, drying areas, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific services, so those remain null. The on-site restaurant is confirmed by the home page and services page. OSM phone field is blank but the website clearly lists 250-845-7112; the OSM address uses 'Yellowhead Highway' while the website uses 'Yellowhead 16 W', a minor formatting difference for the same location.
concerns: OSM has no phone number recorded; website lists 250-845-7112 (and toll-free 1-800-994-8333) — phone added from website.
OSM address is 'Yellowhead Highway'; website consistently uses 'Yellowhead 16 W' — likely the same road but OSM tag omits the highway number designation.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel on a major cycling highway with confirmed amenities including laundry and Wi-Fi. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site restaurant confirmed by home page and services page — relevant for touring cyclists needing an evening meal without leaving the property.
